title: Application for Free Legal Aid (DLSA)
description: An application to the District Legal Services Authority for a free lawyer, legal advice, drafting and court fee support.

fields.name: eligibility
fields.label: You are eligible as
options: a member of a Scheduled Caste / Scheduled Tribe
a victim of trafficking or begar
a victim of a mass disaster, ethnic violence, caste atrocity, flood, drought or earthquake
a person whose annual income is below the limit prescribed by the State

fields.name: case_stage
fields.label: Stage of the matter
options: not yet filed in any court (pre-litigation)

fields.name: court_case_details
fields.label: Court and case number, if pending (optional)

fields.name: enclosures
fields.label: Documents attached (one per line)
fields.placeholder:
Identity proof
Income certificate / affidavit
Caste certificate (if applicable)
Case papers

document.subject: Application for free legal services under Section 12 of the Legal Services Authorities Act, 1987
intro: I, {applicant_name}, aged {applicant_age} years ({applicant_gender}), residing at {applicant_address}, respectfully submit as follows:
pre_facts: I am entitled to free legal services under Section 12 of the Legal Services Authorities Act, 1987, as I am {eligibility}.[[ My annual family income is Rs. {annual_income}.]]
Nature of my legal problem: {case_nature}. Present stage: {case_stage}.[[ Case details: {court_case_details}.]]
paragraphs: I am unable to engage a lawyer at my own cost, and Article 39A of the Constitution of India guarantees free legal aid so that no citizen is denied justice by reason of economic or other disabilities.
document.prayer_intro: I therefore request you to kindly:
prayer: assign a panel lawyer to advise and represent me in the above matter;
provide assistance in drafting the necessary applications, petitions or replies;
bear the court fees and other expenses as permissible under the Regulations; and
refer the matter to Lok Adalat or mediation, if suitable.
closing: I declare that the information given above is true and correct to the best of my knowledge and belief, and I undertake to inform the Authority of any change in my financial circumstances.
